parts:
Dear lavaan community,

I am working on a project to check if students improved their scores over time in reading maturity, a 6-dimension construct. I hope to obtain the unstandardized factor scores at pre and post test times (two time points) to obtain the improvement in the 6 dimensions. So far I am only able to obtain the standardized factor scores.

I first tried the latent change score model with lavaan without much success. Someone suggested that since there are only two time points, I should use a latent regression model instead. In both cases, though, I was only able to get the standardized factor scores, making it impossible to determine the change or improvement in each of the dimensions. 

The following is the lavaan code, Any advice on where I might be wrong would be greatly appreciated.

#estimation of pretest factors using indicator variables

parts: I guess lavaan cannot understand this part
Post1 ~ c*1 + b1*Pre1 Post2 ~ c*2 + b2*Pre2 Post3 ~ c*3 + b3*Pre3 Post4 ~ c*4 + b4*Pre4 Post5 ~ c*5 + b5*Pre5 Post6 ~ c*6 + b6*Pre6

The letter ‘c’ is a label that constrains all parameters that it precedes to be equal, but there is no parameter 2, 3, …, 6.
If you want to constrain the intercept to be equal in cases, it should be

Post1 ~ c*1 + b1*Pre1 Post2 ~ c*1 + b2*Pre2 . . . Post6 ~ c*1 + b6*Pre6

If you want to freely estimate them, I guess you can just take out the 'c'.

Best,

Yago

The letter ‘c’ is a label that constrains all parameters that it precedes to be equal, but there is no parameter 2, 3, …, 6.
If you want to constrain the intercept to be equal in cases, it should be

If you want to freely estimate them, I guess you can just take out the 'c'.

On Tuesday, February 27, 2024 at 7:53:57 AM UTC-6 yagol...@gmail.com wrote:

I guess lavaan cannot understand this part

Post1 ~ c*1 + b1*Pre1 Post2 ~ c*2 + b2*Pre2 Post3 ~ c*3 + b3*Pre3 Post4 ~ c*4 + b4*Pre4 Post5 ~ c*5 + b5*Pre5 Post6 ~ c*6 + b6*Pre6

The letter ‘c’ is a label that constrains all parameters that it precedes to be equal, but there is no parameter 2, 3, …, 6.
If you want to constrain the intercept to be equal in cases, it should be

Post1 ~ c*1 + b1*Pre1 Post2 ~ c*1 + b2*Pre2 . . . Post6 ~ c*1 + b6*Pre6

If you want to freely estimate them, I guess you can just take out the 'c'.

Best,
